_dueno_unico: Un batch de looks es DATOS. El programa que los emite es outfit.py.
_step_0: Sus últimos 16 looks: Calabozo 3 · Penthouse 3 · Club 3 · Bikini/Lencería 2 · VIP 2 · Girly 1 · Editorial 1 · Gym 1. Contra las metas del perfil §6, los deficitarios son Girly Girl (6% vs 12%), Gym (6% vs 12%) y Editorial (6% vs 9%). Estos 5 los cubren y salen del bloque de lencería del batch anterior.
_cuotas: Rosa firma presente en los 5 (obligatorio). Calzado CON PLATAFORMA en los 5, sin excepción (la única pieza 100% inamovible). Silueta cubierta ≥1 de cada 4: la pagan L68 (catsuit, M9) y L70 (vestido, M6). Bata abierta ≥1 de cada 2 en VIP/Penthouse: la paga L69, el único VIP del batch.
negative_extra: matte natural fabric, cotton, wool, tweed, denim, flat shoes, block heel, wedge, heels without platform, bangs, fringe over the forehead

66.concepto: Girly Girl adulta en registro Moschino de pasarela — el rosa exagerado como alta costura, nunca de guardería. Único arquetipo donde su expresión se ablanda a cálida y sonriente (§2, quiebre deliberado de personaje).

adn_overrides.intense shimmer smokey eye technique: intense shimmer rose-quartz and champagne smokey eye technique

66.bloque_b: a bubblegum pink patent vinyl couture mini dress: a structured sweetheart neckline with moulded cups, short puffed cap sleeves, a hem cut high on the thigh with a stiff flared peplum, an oversized architectural bow in cream patent vinyl mounted at the left hip; a bubblegum pink vinyl thong beneath; sheer blush hold-up stockings with a cream satin band; a cream vinyl choker with no lettering and a single pink enamel heart charm; platform Mary Jane stiletto pumps in bubblegum pink patent vinyl, 16cm heel plus 5-inch cream platform, closed rounded toe, a single instep strap with a cream enamel button, cream lacquered sole edge
66.setting: a pink lacquered luxury salon with a cream velvet chaise, gilded mirrors and a wall of fresh peonies, warm diffused key light

67.concepto: Gym en el registro frío de siempre — sudor glam sobre wet-look, cuerpo de gimnasio a la vista. La pierna NO va en leggings (corrección 11/08): aquí va desnuda con calcetín corto cromado.

adn_overrides.intense shimmer smokey eye technique: intense shimmer gunmetal and steel smokey eye technique

67.bloque_b: a gunmetal chrome wet-look spandex athletic set: a high-neck zip-front sports bra with a chrome ring pull, no sleeves, cut to sit just under the bust, paired with high-cut wet-look micro shorts cut as a thong at the back with a narrow tapered front panel and a thin waistband high on the hip bones; a hot pink neon vinyl stripe down the outer seam of each short and a hot pink chrome ring at the zip pull; bare legs, no stockings, with short chrome-lamé socks folded at the ankle; a gunmetal chrome choker with no lettering; platform stiletto trainers in gunmetal chrome patent, 15cm heel plus 5-inch chrome platform, closed rounded toe, laced through chrome eyelets with a hot pink lace, mirrored chrome sole plate
67.setting: a private mirrored training studio at night, chrome racks and black rubber flooring, hard directional spots bouncing off the mirrored wall and the wet-look fabric

68.concepto: Editorial de portada: fondo controlado, la silueta lo es todo. Paga la cuota de silueta cubierta (M9, catsuit de pierna completa) — la primera de las dos del batch.

adn_overrides.intense shimmer smokey eye technique: intense shimmer rose-gold and copper smokey eye technique

68.bloque_b: a dusty rose liquid latex catsuit covering the body from throat to ankle: a high mock-neck collar, long sleeves to the wrist, full-length legs moulded to the calf, a mirror-chrome zip running the full length of the front and drawn down to the sternum, the waist cinched by a hot pink patent vinyl underbust corset belt with chrome boning; no stockings, the catsuit covers the leg; a chrome choker with no lettering; platform stiletto ankle boots in dusty rose patent latex, 16cm heel plus 5-inch chrome platform, closed pointed toe, a mirror-chrome side zip, chrome sole edge
68.setting: a seamless editorial cyclorama in cold pearl grey, a single hard key light and a rose gel rim from behind, nothing else in frame

69.concepto: VIP/Privado: sala privada, uno a uno, sin dominación. Arquitectura M10 (slip dress de malla sobre lencería) — cubre la silueta sin tapar el morbo. Paga además la cuota de bata abierta del arquetipo (§5.1b): la bata enmarca, el slip dress es la prenda.

adn_overrides.intense shimmer smokey eye technique: intense shimmer champagne and bronze smokey eye technique

69.bloque_b: a champagne mesh slip dress worn as the main garment over the lingerie beneath, sheer enough to read the set through it: a bias-cut cowl neckline, no sleeves with fine spaghetti straps, a hem falling to mid-calf with a split to the thigh on one side; beneath it a hot pink liquid latex longline bra and a matching hot pink latex thong with a narrow tapered front panel, a thin waistband high on the hip bones and a single slim strip at the back leaving the seat uncovered; over both, a floor-length champagne wet-satin robe worn open, its hem sweeping the floor, its sash hanging loose and never tied; sheer champagne hold-up stockings with a straight back seam; a chrome choker with no lettering; closed pointed-toe platform stiletto pumps in champagne patent vinyl, 15cm heel plus 4.5-inch platform, sharp closed pointed toe, two champagne satin ankle straps with chrome pin buckles, chrome sole edge
69.setting: a private VIP lounge of a members club, deep champagne velvet banquettes, a low smoked-glass table with cut crystal, amber lamplight and a curtain of beads at the entrance

props.wall: a padded champagne velvet wall panel

70.concepto: Club/Escenario, su arquetipo de mayor peso (18%). Segunda silueta cubierta del batch (M6, vestido) — el escenario no obliga a dos piezas.

adn_overrides.intense shimmer smokey eye technique: intense shimmer magenta and violet smokey eye technique

70.bloque_b: an electric magenta high-gloss vinyl mini dress: an architectural one-shoulder asymmetric neckline with the right shoulder bare, a single long sleeve on the left arm only, a hem cut high on the thigh, the body moulded and seamless with a mirror-chrome zip at the side; a magenta vinyl thong beneath; sheer black hold-up stockings with a chrome-clasp suspender belt just visible at the hem; a mirror-chrome choker with no lettering and a single chrome cuff on the bare right wrist; closed pointed-toe platform stiletto pumps in mirror-chrome, 17cm heel plus 5.5-inch chrome platform, sharp closed pointed toe, two chrome ankle straps with pin buckles, mirrored chrome sole edge
70.setting: the mirrored stage of an upscale club, a chrome pole to one side, magenta and cold white spotlights cutting through low haze, the mirrored floor doubling the gloss

props.seat: the edge of the mirrored stage

_correccion_29_08: L69: llevaba `platform mule` y su arquetipo es VIP/Privado. El mule es EXCLUSIVO de Lenceria (Ama 09/07/2026) -- lo caza `outfit.py auditar`. Cambiado a sandalia de plataforma con tobilleras.
_correccion_29_08_step0: L69 salió primero como M3 (conjunto de lencería) y el linter lo cazó: M3 ya estaba dentro de la ventana global de 3 arquitecturas (previos M6, M3, M9). Rediseñado a M10, que además está en la lista de VIP del perfil §5.6 y suma una tercera silueta cubierta al batch.
